description: Amidst ongoing pandemic concerns, critics question the US government's coordination and response efficacy. Criticisms encompass delays, uneven vaccine distribution, partisan discord, and inequities. Urgent calls for a thorough review and reform emphasize the vital need for adaptable crisis management moving forward.

title: Critics Point to Failures in U.S. Government's COVID-19 Response Amid Ongoing Pandemic
